scope: Read-only independent visual comparison of generated NECA Kwei prototype A/B candidates against two existing product photos. Not a film-mask certification, exact sculpture/UV proof or human artistic validation.
decision: Both candidates suitable for review with explicit prototype/source-interpretation limitations; no major correction requested.

sculptReview.crown: Tall rounded gold-bronze framework and silver petal/teardrop inserts, lateral silver temple rail and low swept brow layers correspond to source photo2. Opposite-view photo3 supports corresponding side construction without mirroring the final image.
sculptReview.cheeks: Dark temple/cheek plate, bronze round temple detail and maroon/red-brown layered cheek structures remain visible. The major near-side bronze triangular wing fin and slim far fin retain their source roles and relative placement.
sculptReview.muzzle: Long silver recessed center strip, narrow dark eye lenses, downward side edges and short adjacent recesses remain. No new teeth, long fangs, horns or wearer anatomy observed.
sculptReview.proportions: A and B retain comparable crown/cheek/muzzle proportions and nearly identical whole-mask visible aspect. Photo comparison uses manually selected CSS display windows; it is not a calibrated silhouette segmentation.
sculptReview.wearerRemoval: No visible skin, eyes/irises, dreadlocks, bands on hair, neck, clothing, weapons, logos or product-photo background remain in the generated cuts. Rear edges exposed by removal remain interpretations of an occluded source boundary.

paletteReview.A: Source-like worn toy paint grain is retained, somewhat more pronounced at full native detail.
paletteReview.B: Broad palette regions retained; smoother grain and clearer material/reflection hierarchy provide the requested PHG rendering adaptation.

alphaReview.warning: Top/bottom native margins are below the requested8–12percent. A bottom27px and B bottom29px are clear and do not clip the muzzle/fins; keep the framing limitation explicit.

ABReadOnlyImageMetrics.metricScope: B stability against generated A only; not canonical/source-photo accuracy.

limitations.finding: Small temple cartouche glyph shapes, tiny crown perforations, engraving line widths and individual surface pits are interpreted; exact sculpt/mark-count fidelity is unproven.
Finer source contact/occluded back geometry cannot be established after wearer/dreadlock removal; no hidden rear/profile/interior claim.
Both images have smaller top/bottom margin than requested but no observed clipping.
The photographed licensed prototype itself is explicitly Not Final; neither A nor B establishes the final film Kwei mask1:1.

browserEvidence.method: Original JPEG/PNG bytes served locally and displayed with CSS scaling/overflow for observational comparison only. No source/candidate raster crop, resize, recolor or re-encode.
